item.title: Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable and iPhone 18 Pro Lineup
item.description:
Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable and iPhone 18 Pro Lineup

At the “Surprise and Shine” event in Cupertino on September 9, Apple officially unveiled a new generation of hardware, including its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5. AI serves as the common thread across this new ecosystem.

📱 iPhone Duo

The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable iPhone, featuring a Grade 5 titanium build and a precision-engineered hinge with more than 100 components.

  • Displays: A 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR inner display (more than 50% larger than the iPhone 18 Pro Max) and a 5.4-inch external display.
  • Durability: IP68 rating and Ceramic Shield 2 on the outer display, which Apple claims has up to three times greater scratch resistance than the previous generation.
  • Performance: Powered by the A20 Pro chip, utilizing a dual-battery architecture and a vapor-chamber cooling system.
  • Display Tech: Supports ProMotion and Always-On capabilities with a peak outdoor brightness of 3,000 nits.
  • Expanded Utility: Support for Apple Pencil USB-C is coming later this year for sketching, note-taking, and document annotation.

📸 iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max

These models focus on AI, battery life, performance, and camera capabilities, powered by the A20 Pro chip and a new-generation vapor-chamber cooling system for high sustained performance.

  • Camera System: Features a 48MP Fusion main camera with variable aperture. The system can automatically optimize aperture for depth of field and lighting, or users can manually select from four levels.
  • Video and Audio: Supports 4K Dolby Vision HDR time-lapse and cinematic effects applied after recording at up to 60 fps. Audio Mix has been improved for voice processing.
  • Imaging: Additional Photographic Styles controls for image grain and texture.

⌚ Apple Watch Series 12

Powered by the S11 chip, the Series 12 introduces a Health Sensing System combining electrical and optical sensors to measure heart rate variability (HRV) and heart rate every five seconds.

  • AI Integration: watchOS 27 brings Siri AI to the device to combine personal context with broader knowledge. New Audio Intelligence capabilities will arrive later this year.
  • Materials: Available in aluminum, titanium, and a ceramic option (available in Night and Pearl White).

⚙️ Key Details

Product Colors Storage / Materials Price / Availability
iPhone Duo Star White, Night Sky 256GB to 2TB Starts at $1,999; Sales Oct 23
iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max Black, Silver, Glacier, Burgundy N/A Retail availability Sept 18

🚀 Availability

  • iPhone Duo: Pre-orders begin October 16; sales start October 23. Available in more than 70 countries, including Vietnam.
  • iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max: Pre-orders begin September 12; retail availability starts September 18. Vietnam is included in first-wave pre-orders.

#Apple #iPhoneDuo #iPhone18Pro #AppleWatch #AI

Source: Apple Unveils New Product Lineup: Foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5 - TechTimes.vn

item.title: Marvell to Showcase AI Data Center Connectivity and Memory Solutions
item.description:
Marvell to Showcase AI Data Center Connectivity and Memory Solutions

Marvell Technology, Inc. has announced it will present its portfolio of AI data center connectivity and memory solutions at the AI Infra Summit 2026, taking place September 15 to 17 in Santa Clara, California.

⚙️ Key details

Marvell will highlight advances in its end-to-end data center connectivity portfolio for scale-up, scale-out, and scale-across applications at Booth #704. The showcase includes:

Solution Function/Capability
Marvell® Photonic Fabric™ Technology Enables memory sharing across multiple racks, extending scale beyond traditional distance constraints
Marvell RELIANT™ Interconnect Telemetry Platform Provides real-time visibility into the health and performance of AI data center infrastructure connectivity across optical and electrical links
Marvell Teralynx® T100 102 Tbps Ethernet switch device delivering increased bandwidth and efficiency for large-scale AI networks
PCIe 6.0 Switch 256-lane design to connect more accelerators and devices within scale-up AI systems
CXL-based memory solutions Supports expansion, compression, pooling, and near-memory acceleration to reduce dataset movement between XPUs and accelerate large-scale vector databases
DPUs and Ethernet switching Deliver high-performance access to NVMe storage across the network
PCIe® 6.0 NVMe SSD controller Optimized for next-generation enterprise and AI storage

🔍 Overview

During the summit, Marvell executives will participate in panels and presentations regarding connectivity and networking for next-generation AI data center infrastructure. This includes a keynote presentation titled “AI Inference at Scale” delivered by Dave Lazovsky, Executive Vice President and General Manager of the Data Center Networking Business Group.

#Marvell #AIDataCenter #Semiconductors #Networking #AIInfraSummit

Source: Marvell to Showcase End-to-End AI Data Center Connectivity Portfolio at AI Infra Summit 2026
